kinds.a: PAC · mobile air conditioner · floor-standing AC · monobloc
kinds.d: Movable single-box refrigerant unit on castors that exhausts heat outdoors through a window hose.

kinds.a: swamp cooler · desert cooler · air cooler · wet air cooler
kinds.d: Fan that blows air through a water-soaked pad to cool by evaporation; adds humidity, so suits dry climates and is not an air conditioner.
t: outdoor / patio cooler with hose feed
